default_in_repayment.text:
(a) In our opinion and according to the information
and explanations given to us, the Company has
not defaulted in repayment of loans to bank.
(b) The Company has not been declared willful
defaulter by any bank or financial institution or
government or any government authority.
(c) To the best of our knowledge and belief, in our
opinion, term loans availed by the Company were,
applied by the Company during the year for the
purposes for which the loans were obtained.
(d) On an overall examination of the financial
statements of the Company, funds raised on shortterm
basis have, prima facie, not been used during
the year for long-term purposes by the Company.
(e) On an overall examination of the financial
statements of the Company, the Company has
not taken any funds from any entity or person
on account of or to meet the obligations of its
subsidiaries.
(f) The Company has not raised loans during the year
on the pledge of securities held in its subsidiaries.

business_summary.text: OneSource Specialty Pharma is a specialty pharmaceutical CDMO focusing on complex products including biologics, drug-device combinations, and sterile injectables.

call_points.text: FY28 outlook of $400 million organic revenue and 40% EBITDA margin reiterated.
Sequential quarter-on-quarter revenue and EBITDA improvement promised for the rest of FY27.
Second cartridge line commercialises this quarter, doubling sterile days; third line within FY27, fourth later in FY28.
Sterile-injectable site shutdown in Q2 and Q3 to add pre-filled syringe and lyophilisation capacity.
All three Canadian semaglutide approvals are with OneSource; two partners have launched.
Over 40% of India's generic pen market is supplied from its site as of June 26.
Biologics RFP funnel is almost 4x a year ago; Formycon added as a biosimilar customer.
Opex for new lines is already in the base, so incremental line revenue should carry limited extra cost.
Dr. Reddy's temporary supply disruption has not hit OneSource; capacities are full from other customers.
US tariff talk and Middle East freight disruption seen as muted because contracts are ex-works.
Soft gelatin capacity added is expected to be fully taken over the next 12 to 15 months; a greenfield is being initiated.
Second DDC line is at site undergoing qualification and will be commercialized next quarter.
Customer base holds nearly two-thirds of the Indian generic Semaglutide market share by value.

operating_notes.text: OneSource supported partner Orbicular as CDMO for tentative U.S. ANDA approval of generic Ozempic (Semaglutide Injection).
Sterile Product Division facility in Bangalore received EU GMP Certificate from the State Office for Occupational Safety, Social Affairs and Health of Schleswig-Holstein, Germany.
Partner Dr. Reddy's Laboratories received Health Canada approval for generic Semaglutide Injection, with OneSource providing scale-up and commercial manufacturing.
Partner Orbicular received Health Canada approval for generic semaglutide injection, with OneSource as manufacturing partner; commercial supply from US FDA-approved Bengaluru facility.
FY26 revenue ₹1,421.59 Cr, down 1.6% YoY, with EBITDA margin at 21.4% versus 32.3% in FY25.
Q4FY26 raw material cost was ₹144.51 Cr, up 58.8% YoY, against revenue of ₹428.22 Cr.
Board decided not to pursue the composite scheme to acquire SteriScience's Poland and Baroda facilities in its current form, to revisit after FY28 guidance.
Karnataka's 67th SHLCC (April 13, 2026) cleared in-principle incentives for Onesource's Unit II expansion at Obadenahalli, KIADB Industrial Area, Doddaballapur Taluk; no cost or capacity stated.
Each cartridge line provides about 225 sterile days a year; three lines give 675 sterile days for FY28.
More than 40% of generic pens sold in India as of June 26, 2026 were manufactured at OneSource's site.
Almost 80% of the $100 million capex programme has been committed, mostly to drug device combination.
Effective April 01, 2025, the company evaluates performance as a single segment: Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO).
Biolexis is contesting a USD 136.32 million claim from Prestige Biopharma regarding Sputnik vaccine contract termination.
Second cartridge line commercialised in Q2FY27, doubling sterile production days.
Factory Acceptance Testing completed for cartridge line 3.
First generic Semaglutide launched in KSA by Hikma.
USFDA inspection of Bengaluru SPD facility (June 22-30, 2026) concluded with VAI classification in October 2026.

timeline.summary: OneSource announced tentative U.S. FDA approval for generic Ozempic (Semaglutide Injection) with partner Orbicular.
Onesource Specialty Pharma received EU GMP certification for its Bangalore sterile facility from German authorities.
Onesource Specialty Pharma announced that partner Dr. Reddy's Laboratories received Health Canada approval for generic Semaglutide Injection, with OneSource as CDMO.
OneSource partner Orbicular received Health Canada approval for generic Ozempic (semaglutide injection), the second such Canadian approval, with OneSource as manufacturing partner.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹428.22 Cr, net profit ₹4.6 Cr.
OneSource's board decided on 2026-05-13 not to pursue the composite scheme to acquire SteriScience's Poland and Baroda facilities in its current form, to revisit after FY28 guidance.
Onesource Specialty Pharma published the audio recording of its earnings call for Q4 and FY26 results.

2026-05-16: Karnataka granted in-principle approval under KIP 2025–30 for incentives on Onesource's Unit II expansion at Obadenahalli, Bengaluru Rural District (Government Order CI 120 SPI 2026 dated May 12, 2026).

OneSource's Q1FY27 earnings call (July 25, 2026) reported revenue of ₹449 Cr, up 37% YoY, and EBITDA of ₹123.3 Cr, up 39% YoY, with the FY28 outlook of $400 million revenue and 40% EBITDA margin reiterated.
OneSource Specialty Pharma Limited schedules earnings call with analysts/investors on October 27, 2026, at 18:30 IST to discuss Q2FY27 unaudited results.
H1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹965.26 Cr, net profit ₹82.48 Cr.
H1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹965.26 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹82.48 Cr.
Audio recording of earnings call for unaudited results of quarter ended September 30, 2026 made available on company website on 27 October 2026.
OneSource Specialty Pharma's Bengaluru sterile facility received a USFDA EIR with VAI classification, concluding the June 2026 inspection.
